learning: After the first race telemetry, I will analyze line loss events and rms error to tune sensor weights and PID gains. I will also monitor steering oscillation to adjust kd and sensor layout if needed for smoother control.
rationale: The geometry provides a balanced sensor array with 5 sensors symmetrically spaced across the front, medium sensor size, and moderate body and wheel dimensions for stable control. I chose a PID controller with moderate base speed and gains tuned for responsive but stable line following. Sensor weights are set to reflect sensor positions for proportional error correction. The line loss strategy is set to search_left to recover from line loss effectively. This setup should provide good generalization across oval and s-bend tracks, supporting stable line detection and control. The observation request includes completion, progress, rms_error, line_loss_events, and steering_oscillation to evaluate performance and guide future tuning.
